resources.string: Sikkanam keeps your money, prayer, and jamaat records on this phone. Nothing is sent anywhere, except when you tap Update list or Update directory (internet), or open an email to send a message yourself.

Add income or spending with the + Add button. Choose a category, who or what it is for, and the account it came from. Use the arrows to move between months. Search by category or note, filter by income or spending, and export everything to CSV.
Add your cash, bank, and card accounts with the amount you had at the start. Use Transfer to move money between two accounts. Each account balance follows the entries made to it.
Set a monthly limit for a category. The bar shows how much is spent. It turns red when you go over.

Create a savings goal with a target and add money to it. Tap History to see every amount, and edit or delete a wrong one. Money lent and borrowed is recorded under Debts with an optional due date. Record each repayment as it is paid.

During the first week of each month, Home shows last month: money in and out, savings, and any budget that went over. Reminders come the day before a monthly bill is due, a day before your zakat date, 10 minutes before each prayer, and on a debt due date. Turn prayer reminders off in Settings if you do not want them.

Prayer shows today\'s five prayers and sunrise for the city you choose in Settings. You can pick standard or Hanafi Asr. Qibla turns with the phone and tells you which way to turn. Islamic dates lists Ramadan, Eid, Arafah and other key days. The daily personal amaal checklist has Quran tilawat, morning and evening tasbeehat, the five prayers in jamaat, nawafil, and finding halal rizq; tick each one as you do it. The dhikr and Quran tracker counts dhikr and pages read each day.

Open Islamic and tap Books. Update list shows the books published on smatechsolution.com. Tap Download to keep a copy on this phone, then Read to open it. Import a book lets you choose any EPUB, PDF or TXT file on the phone. Books open without internet. The place you stopped is saved, and Continue reading returns to it. Remove deletes the copy from the phone.

Zakat works out 2.5% on the wealth above nisab, using silver or gold. Inheritance (faraid) shows each share for the spouse, parents, sons and daughters, after debts. Check every case with a scholar, because brothers, sisters, grandchildren and wills are not included.
Record sadaqah and purification here. Mark income as halal, doubtful, or haram, and expenses as riba when they are interest. The page shows how much purification is still due.

Surahs, duas, adhan, prayer steps, funeral prayer, and halal and haram, each with Arabic, transliteration and meaning in Tamil and English. Tap a title to open it, and tick it when you have learned it. Check the content with a teacher before teaching it.

Create a jamaat for a khurooj and add its members. Record each member\'s expenses, money in, and advance. Under each jamaat you can keep the daily mashwara, duties, the daily muqami amaal checklist, the weekly programmes (halqa mashwara, city mashwara, shabgujari), and khurooj records with dates and places.

Dawat and taskeel records the people you meet, their status, and follow-up dates. Once someone agrees to khurooj, form a new jamaat from them. The locality register lists people in the area, the khurooj they have done, and which khurooj they are available for. Tap Met today to record a meeting and the taskeel given, and the monthly list shows who was given taskeel for each khurooj.

Services lists electricians, plumbers, housekeepers and businesses with their phone numbers. Tap Call to open the dialer. The network lists the states, districts, zones, halqas and masjids. Tap Update to download the latest lists (internet needed). Use Add my listing or Suggest a place to send details by email.

Write personal notes with a title and text, such as a reminder, a list, or a summary. Type in Search notes to find a note by its title or text. Tap a note to read all of it. Use Edit to change a note or Delete to remove it. Notes are saved on this phone and included in the backup.

Choose the language (system, English, or Tamil) and the text size. Switch the Islamic and Jamaat pages on or off. Pick the prayer city and Asr method, set the zakat date, lock the app with fingerprint or screen lock, save or restore a backup, check for updates, and send feedback.
Save a backup from Settings every month, and before you change phones. A backup includes all your money, jamaat, dawat, and locality records. Restoring a backup replaces the data on the phone.

Record bus, train and flight bookings by hand, with the operator, route, times, booking reference, fare and seat. Upcoming and past trips are listed separately. Link a booking to a jamaat trip to show it on that trip. A reminder is sent 12 hours before departure. The app does not search for or book tickets. Bookings are saved on this phone and included in the backup.
